usage.ground: Page background and input fields. Body text in `ink` and context in `muted` sit on it.
usage.surface: Masthead, navigation band, shelf folios, the selected-book pane and popovers. One step deeper than `ground`.
usage.ink: Body copy, titles and control labels on `ground`, `surface`, `selection-fill`, `pressed-fill` and `evidence-well`.
usage.muted: Context that is still reading content: authors in shelf captions, series, counts, labels, disclosure summaries. Reads on every surface `ink` does.
usage.accent: Teal Means Here: action, focus ring, selection, live state, links, the current navigation underline and `Direct match`/`In a collection` status. Never decoration.
usage.on-accent: Label text on an `accent` or `accent-hover` fill, and selected text (`::selection`).
usage.copper: Identity and headings: page `h1`, detail-section `h3`, folio position numerals, the folio rule and the library check dot. Can be violet or gold in other themes.
usage.line: Control edges (buttons, inputs, selects, the Shelves/List group), the selected-edge inset and scrollbar thumbs. Meets 3:1 as a meaningful edge.
usage.soft-line: Quiet separators between related material: masthead bottom, shelf heading rule, list rows, disclosure rules, folio borders. Not a control edge.
usage.selection-fill: One Fill Rule: the selected work row and the pressed state of a browsing choice (`aria-pressed=true`).
usage.pressed-fill: Hover (gated by `(hover: hover)`) and `:active` on buttons and rows.
usage.evidence-well: Comparison and status wells (`.comparison`, `.source-claim`, `.library-status-well`), the lower stop of the folio gradient, loading placeholders.
usage.progress-track: Unfilled part of a `<progress>` bar; the value is `accent`.
usage.attention: Attention Rose: failure wording, error notices, the failed job state, browse-view and theme-picker notices. Always beside words, never colour alone.
usage.brand-ink: Librarium A emblem ink (`--librarium-ink`). The supplied ivory, or the theme's `ink` where no brand role is supplied.
usage.brand-accent: Librarium A emblem accent (`--librarium-accent`): the circular seal and binding. Supplied brass, or the theme's `copper` as fallback.

styles.name: display

styles.name: pane-title

styles.name: shelf-heading

styles.name: list-title

styles.name: series-position
